name: Solar EPC and installers

problems.words: Panel prices change every week and my old quotes become loss-making
quick_ideas: Put a clear validity date on every quote, so old prices don't bind you
Check open quotes against today's supplier prices once, to see which are at risk.

workzap_build.text: A quote builder that pulls current supplier prices, shows margin before sending and flags every quote as it nears expiry.

problems.ask_first: How long is a quote valid for today?
problems.free_stops: Pricing logic and validity rules are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Compare this week's supplier rates with your still-open quotes, so you spot which pending jobs could wipe out margin.
Keep one notebook page for open quotes awaiting supplier price checks each morning, so outdated offers get caught before acceptance.

problems.words: Customers call every day asking about their net metering status
quick_ideas: Keep one list of every pending file with its current stage, so anyone in the office can answer
Send each waiting customer one short status update, so they know where things stand.

workzap_build.text: A net metering tracker per customer with stage and documents checklist, sending a WhatsApp update whenever a file moves.

problems.ask_first: Roughly how many files are pending right now?
problems.free_stops: Stages, document lists and message triggers are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Note how many status calls come in before noon about pending net metering files, so the daily interruption load becomes visible.
Give one office person the midday update round for pending files, so incoming calls reduce and the team keeps working.

problems.words: Serial numbers of panels and inverters are not recorded per customer
quick_ideas: Photograph serial labels at every installation, so warranty claims have proof
Keep those photos in one folder per job, so they can be found later.

workzap_build.text: A stock register with serial numbers per panel batch and inverter, linked directly to each installation and warranty.

problems.ask_first: Do you hold stock or buy per order?
problems.free_stops: How serials link to stock and jobs is in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count recent completed jobs missing panel or inverter label photos, so you see the warranty record backlog clearly.
Make the site supervisor responsible for sending label photos before leaving each completed job, so warranty proof reaches the office reliably.

problems.words: Lots of enquiries, most just want a price to compare
quick_ideas: Ask a few qualifying questions before sending anyone for a survey, so surveyor time goes to serious buyers
Call the most promising leads first each morning.

workzap_build.text: Lead intake from WhatsApp, Facebook and the website with qualifying questions, follow-up reminders and a daily view of which leads turn into surveys.

problems.free_stops: The question set and lead scoring are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many fresh enquiries ask only for a price and never discuss a site visit, so weak leads are separated early.
Give one person the morning callback list and one notebook page for serious enquiries, so survey time goes to stronger prospects.

problems.words: Quotes take two days because each one is done in Excel
quick_ideas: Settle on the handful of standard packages you sell most, so most quotes start from a base
Give one person the quoting job each day, so surveys don't queue.

workzap_build.text: A survey form on phone that feeds a quote builder directly, so a quote can go out the same day the survey is done.

problems.free_stops: Package structure and survey fields are in the solution document; equipment sizing stays with a qualified engineer.

extra_ideas.text: Note which quote details staff retype again and again this week, so you see where quoting time is being lost.
Assign one daily handover time for survey notes to the quoting person, so quotes stop waiting across the whole day.

problems.words: Installation crews double-booked, one site waiting all day
quick_ideas: Put tomorrow's jobs per crew on one sheet each evening, so clashes are seen in advance
Confirm each job with the customer the day before, so crews don't arrive to a closed gate.

workzap_build.text: A crew board sending daily WhatsApp job sheets and collecting completion check-ins from every crew.

problems.ask_first: How many installation teams do you have?
problems.free_stops: Scheduling rules are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many jobs changed crew or timing after the evening plan this week, so the main source of clashes stands out.
Make one supervisor own the next-day crew board before closing time, so no site waits because two teams were sent elsewhere.

problems.words: Customers pay the advance and delay the balance after installation
quick_ideas: List every outstanding balance with the date the job was finished, so the total owed is clear
Agree the balance date in writing before installation, so expectations are set.

workzap_build.text: A payment milestone tracker that sends balance reminders after installation and shows ageing every day.

problems.free_stops: Milestone structure and reminder timing are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many installed jobs still have balance pending after handover this week, so you see where cash is getting stuck.
Give one staff member the balance-follow-up notebook and a fixed daily handover time, so delayed collections stop slipping between teams.

problems.words: Commissioning photos and test records are on installers' phones
quick_ideas: Ask installers to send handover photos to one office number, so records leave personal phones
Store them per job, so after-sales has them.

workzap_build.text: An installation and commissioning checklist with photos and readings saved per job upon completion.

problems.free_stops: Checklist content is in the solution document; technical standards stay with your engineer.

extra_ideas.text: Count completed jobs whose commissioning photos or test records are still only on installers' phones, so missing office files are clear.
Choose one office chat for all commissioning photos and records the same day, so after-sales can find each job quickly.

problems.words: Nobody tracks which customers are due panel cleaning or a check-up
quick_ideas: List past installations by date, so you know who is due
Contact those who agreed to hear from you, so the service work comes back to you.

workzap_build.text: You would see a maintenance reminder schedule for each installation, sent on its own to customers who agreed to hear from you.

problems.ask_first: Do you offer cleaning or maintenance visits?
problems.free_stops: Reminder timing and service offers are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many past installations from earlier months have had no service follow-up note, so the missed repeat-work pool is visible.
Give one staff member a weekly list of older installations to review, so cleaning and check-up work does not get overlooked.

problems.words: Dealers in other cities sell our stock but pay late
quick_ideas: List what each dealer owes and since when, so the exposure is clear
Set a credit limit per dealer, so balances can't keep growing.

workzap_build.text: A dealer ledger with balances, limits and payment reminder messages sent to dealers.

problems.ask_first: How many dealers buy on credit?
problems.free_stops: Credit rules and reminders are in the solution document.

extra_ideas.text: Count how many dealer balances are past the promised date by city, so you see where late cash is piling up.
Give one staff member the late dealer follow-up list at a fixed afternoon time, so chasing payments stops slipping.

never_say: Any system sizing, roof structure, wiring, earthing, battery or fire safety advice; a qualified engineer decides.
Any prediction of savings, payback, generation or that a bill will drop.
Any help selling used panels as new, changing serial labels, faking warranties, misdeclaring imports or bribing utility staff.
Any request to record customer names, addresses, meter or reference numbers, IDs or bank details.
Any view on subsidies, tax or utility policy; electrocution, roof falls or battery fire mean emergency services first.

sample_reply.person: Net metering file ke status ke liye roz itni calls aati hain, koi hal hai is ka?
sample_reply.pi:
Ji haan, shuruaat chhoti si ho sakti hai, aur is ke liye bade kharch ki zaroorat nahi.
Pehle, har pending file ki ek list banayen jis mein us ka current stage likha ho, taake office ka koi bhi banda jawab de sake.
Doosra, har intezar karne wale customer ko ek dafa status ka chhota sa update bhej dein, taake unhein pata ho baat kahan hai.
Is ke liye Workzap ye intezam de sakta hai: har file ka tracker, aur file aage badhte hi customer ko WhatsApp pe update.
